name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs using a wide overhand grip.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Lift the bar close to your body by raising both elbows wide out to the sides up to chest or shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly back down to full arm extension under full control.
tips: Keep your elbows at or below shoulder height to avoid pinching the front of your shoulders.
Keep the bar close and let your shoulder blades move naturally as your elbows rise.
